description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility located in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and driving continuous improvement in quality of care and operational efficiency. This full-time role offers a competitive salary of $115,000 - $145,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Proven leadership and management skills, with a track record of operational success.
Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets effectively.
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, commensurate with experience.
